title: 第9章 有趣的灵魂万里挑一第10章 刻入身体本能的经验
content_zh:
;;
“咕噜噜~”
肚皮发出的哀嚎，打断了克洛伊的思考。
他掀开被子，起身走向洗漱间。
打算收拾一通先去食堂填饱肚子再论其他。
站到光可鉴人的洗手台前，克洛伊望着镜子里的自己。
这是他第一次有闲暇自己端详自己如今的模样。
镜中的少年有着一张堪称俊美的面孔，这点没得黑，毕竟多铎家的基因是真的好。
皮肤很白，头发很黑，五官精致漂亮，如果不是在游戏原剧情中表现得太初生，，相信会有不少玩家三观跟着五官走为他洗地的。
这卖相，克洛伊很满意，但一联想到原主的出身，他就忍不住嘀咕。
“不过，这一头黑发棕眼，放在多铎家还真是格格不入。”
毕竟除了克洛伊之外，包括他的父亲赫曼大公在内，以及他的两个哥哥，一个姐姐，以及最年幼的妹妹，全都是一头银发，一双蓝眼。
这倒不是因为克洛伊的身世有什么的问题，他的确是多铎家的孩子没有错。
甚至其实多铎家的其他人也都并不是一开始就是银发蓝眼的，那是多铎家世代传承的“霜魄血脉”
觉醒之后的固定特征。
在这个充满奇幻色彩的世界里，强大的血脉往往意味着更高的起点、更强的潜力以及独特的天赋能力。
诸如皇室圣罗曼尼亚家族的“苍瞳血脉”
，多铎家族的“霜魄血脉”
，都是屹立于帝国顶端的传奇血脉。
然而可惜的是，明明都已经成年十八岁了，克洛伊却丝毫没有血脉觉醒的征兆，要知道，家里的小妹可是在七岁那年就成功觉醒了血脉成为了家族的骄傲。

而这也正是原身心底极度自卑扭曲的根源之一。
克洛伊还记得，原身这倒霉蛋，可是直到后来剧情杀青嗝屁了，都完全没有觉醒血脉，到死都是一头黑发，一双褐眼。
“算了，想这些没用。”
克洛伊掬起一捧冷水拍在脸上，冰凉的触感让他精神一振。
“天大地大，吃饭最大！”
洗漱完毕，换上一身干净的学院制服，克洛伊便迫不及待地离开了宿舍，朝着学院食堂的方向大步走去。
自从穿越过来，他可是连一口这个世界的食物都还没尝过！
胃里的饥饿感早已经按耐不住，对于异世界的美食，他抱有很高的期待！
......
正值正午午餐时间，学院食堂里人声鼎沸。
空气中弥漫着各种食物的香气，夹杂着欢声笑语。
克洛伊在学院里大小算个名人，而被希琳公主发起誓约决斗之后，那名气可就更大了。

"Gululu~"
Chloe's thoughts were interrupted by the wail coming from her belly.
He lifted the quilt, got up and walked to the bathroom.
I plan to clean up and go to the cafeteria to fill my stomach before talking about anything else.
Standing in front of the bright sink, Chloe looked at herself in the mirror.
This was the first time he had the leisure to look at his current appearance.
The young man in the mirror has a handsome face, which is not bad. After all, the genes of the Dodo family are really good.
His skin is very white, his hair is very dark, and his facial features are exquisite and beautiful. If he didn't appear too naive in the original plot of the game, I believe that many players would follow his facial features and defend him.
Chloe was very satisfied with this appearance, but when he thought about the origin of the original owner, he couldn't help but murmur.
"However, this one with black hair and brown eyes is really out of place in the Dodo family."
After all, except for Chloe, including his father, Archduke Hermann, as well as his two brothers, one sister, and the youngest sister, they all have silver hair and blue eyes.
This is not because there is anything wrong with Chloe's life experience. He is indeed a child of the Dodo family.
In fact, the other members of the Duduo family did not have silver hair and blue eyes at the beginning. They were the "Frost Bloodline" passed down from generation to generation by the Duduo family.
Fixed characteristics after awakening.
In this world full of fantasy, strong bloodline often means a higher starting point, stronger potential and unique talents.
Such as the "Blue Eyes Bloodline" of the Royal Saint Romania Family
, the "Frost Bloodline" of the Duduo family
, are all legendary bloodlines that stand at the top of the empire.
However, it is a pity that although she is already eighteen years old, Chloe shows no signs of awakening her bloodline. You know, the little sister of the family successfully awakened her bloodline at the age of seven and became the pride of the family.
And this is one of the sources of Yuan's extremely low self-esteem and distortion.
Chloe still remembered that she was such an unlucky person, but until the end of the plot, she didn't awaken her bloodline at all, and she had black hair and brown eyes until her death.
"Forget it, there's no point thinking about this."
Chloe picked up a handful of cold water and slapped it on his face. The cold touch refreshed him.
“The sky is big and the earth is big, eating is the biggest thing!”
After washing up and putting on a clean college uniform, Chloe couldn't wait to leave the dormitory and strode towards the college cafeteria.
Ever since he traveled through time, he hasn't even tasted a bite of food from this world!
The hunger in his stomach has long been unbearable, and he has high expectations for the food from another world!
...
It was lunch time, and the college cafeteria was bustling with people.
The air is filled with the aroma of various foods, mixed with laughter and laughter.
Chloe is quite a celebrity in the academy, and after being challenged to a duel by Princess Shireen, her fame became even greater.
